title: 冻结候选的未来时间验证协议
execution: No scheduler, automatic collector, paper account or live orders has been started. This file preregisters a later full-window evaluation; it is not a completed result.
timeEvidence: Only observations generated after this protocol freeze qualify as prospective. Historic held-out-symbol returns must never be merged into this forward result.

warmup.policy: Indicators only before 2026-10-04; start flat at the declared start, no inherited historical positions.

selection: Both candidate identities and all strategy/risk parameters are fixed by the source study. No forward-data ranking, fallback winner, parameter update, coin exclusion or outcome-based end-date changes. Historic cross-asset test results cannot retroactively modify this protocol.

evaluation.interim: Any interim accounting or risk observation is descriptive; no early efficacy declaration. No automatic monitoring is implied.
evaluation.acceptance: Only primary evaluated for acceptance. Full 365-day complete UTC calendar required; positive net return, at least100 closed trades and10each original symbol, daily portfolio drawdown>=-10%, and strictly positive lower95percentile bound of mean daily account return for both7/28circularblocks under each cost. Previous source-domain qualification remains provenance, not forward evidence. Failure or insufficient data=>not-established; baseline does not replace the primary. Passing is evidence under this model, not a profit guarantee.
evaluation.interval: Aggregate fixed sleeves in dollars before returns. Every candidate/cost shares date draws. Within one continuous account no annual resets. Pointwise percentile indices floor(B*.025)/floor(B*.975), not independent-trade confidence.
evaluation.counterfactuals: Baseline paired daily differences and coin/profit concentration are diagnostics only; no new optimizer.

dataPolicy: Use checksum-verified official trade1m, mark1m, and actual funding. No interpolation, invented funding, shortening end date, dropping missing symbols or selective removal of failed trades. If a contract ceases or archives cannot support the declared rules, report evidence unavailable and separately document lifecycle limitations instead of manufacturing a full-year account.
limitations: This protocol has no future observations or performance numbers yet.
Source strategies were adaptively selected on known historical data.
The declared static instrument rules and bps execution assumptions remain limitations; changes require a new protocol version and cannot silently rewrite this one.
Minute backtest replay is not live shadow execution and does not capture order-book depth, queue position, network latency or operational recovery.
